zh.name: 美神圣域
zh.description: 维纳斯展开美神圣域，嘲讽敌方全体，并施加【倾慕】，持续<color=#02ff00>5</color>秒，若目标已拥有【倾慕】，则额外使其攻击力降低<color=#02ff00>50%</color>，持续<color=#02ff00>5</color>秒。持续期间维纳斯每秒获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>8%</color>的护盾。

upgrades.zh: 等级2：持续期间维纳斯每秒获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>9%</color>的护盾。
upgrades.en: During this period, Venus gains a Shield equal to 9% of her max HP every second.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：持续期间维纳斯每秒获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>10%</color>的护盾。
upgrades.en: During this period, Venus gains a Shield equal to 10% of her max HP every second.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：持续期间维纳斯每秒获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>11%</color>的护盾。
upgrades.en: During this period, Venus gains a Shield equal to 11% of her max HP every second.

en.name: Sanctuary of Beauty
en.description: Venus deploys [Sanctuary of Beauty], Taunting all enemies and inflicting [Adoration] for 5s. If the target already has [Adoration], additionally reduces their ATK by 50% for 5s. During this period, Venus gains a Shield equal to 8% of her max HP every second.

zh.name: 晨星护幕
zh.description: 获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>20%</color>的护盾并在接下来8秒内每秒恢复自身<color=#02ff00>8%</color>最大生命值

upgrades.zh: 等级2：获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>25%</color>的护盾
upgrades.en: Gains a Shield equal to 25% of max HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：接下来8秒内每秒恢复自身<color=#02ff00>12%</color>最大生命值
upgrades.en: Restores 12% of max HP every second for the next 8s.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：获得自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>30%</color>的护盾
upgrades.en: Gains a Shield equal to 30% of max HP.

en.name: Morning Star Veil
en.description: Gains a Shield equal to 20% of max HP and restores 8% of max HP every second for the next 8s.

zh.name: 不可亵渎
zh.description: 被动的，维纳斯累计受到相当于自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>25%</color>的伤害时，进入<color=#02ff00>3</color>秒免疫伤害状态，该效果每<color=#02ff00>20</color>秒最多触发<color=#02ff00>1</color>次

upgrades.zh: 等级2：该效果每<color=#02ff00>18</color>秒最多触发<color=#02ff00>1</color>次
upgrades.en: This effect can trigger at most 1 time every 18s.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：触发所需累计伤害降低至自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>20%</color>
upgrades.en: The cumulative DMG required to trigger this effect is reduced to 20% of max HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：该效果每<color=#02ff00>16</color>秒最多触发<color=#02ff00>1</color>次
upgrades.en: This effect can trigger at most 1 time every 16s.

en.name: Inviolable
en.description: Passive: When Venus takes cumulative DMG equal to 25% of her max HP, she becomes Immune to DMG for 3s. This effect can trigger at most 1 time every 20s.

zh.name: 一见倾心
zh.description: 被动的，战斗开始时，维纳斯对敌方攻击力最高的单位施加【倾慕】（倾慕：目标对维纳斯造成的伤害降低<color=#02ff00>20%</color>）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：倾慕：目标对维纳斯造成的伤害降低<color=#02ff00>23%</color>
upgrades.en: [Adoration]: DMG dealt by the target to Venus is reduced by 23%.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：倾慕：目标对维纳斯造成的伤害降低<color=#02ff00>26%</color>
upgrades.en: [Adoration]: DMG dealt by the target to Venus is reduced by 26%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：倾慕：目标对维纳斯造成的伤害降低<color=#02ff00>30%</color>
upgrades.en: [Adoration]: DMG dealt by the target to Venus is reduced by 30%.

en.name: Love at First Sight
en.description: Passive: At the start of battle, Venus inflicts [Adoration] on the enemy unit with the highest ATK ([Adoration]: DMG dealt by the target to Venus is reduced by 20%).

levels.zh: 强化【不可亵渎】，使其免疫伤害时间提升至<color=#02ff00>4</color>秒
levels.en: Enhances [Inviolable], increasing the duration for which it grants immunity to DMG to 4s.

levels.zh: 若维纳斯生命值首次低于<color=#02ff00>40%</color>，额外触发一次【不可亵渎】
levels.en: If Venus's HP drops below 40% for the first time, triggers [Inviolable] an additional time.

levels.zh: 强化【一见倾心】，倾慕：目标对所有友方单位造成的伤害降低<color=#02ff00>30%</color>
levels.en: Enhances [Love at First Sight]. [Adoration]: DMG dealt by the target to all allied units is reduced by 30%.

levels.zh: 【不可亵渎】触发时，维纳斯嘲讽自身周围<color=#02ff00>3</color>米的敌人，持续<color=#02ff00>3</color>秒，场上每有<color=#02ff00>1</color>名正被维纳斯嘲讽的敌人，维纳斯每<color=#02ff00>2</color>秒恢复自身<color=#02ff00>5%</color>最大生命值（最多对<color=#02ff00>5</color>名敌人触发该效果）
levels.en: When [Inviolable] is triggered, Venus Taunts enemies within 3m of herself for 3s. For every 1 enemy currently taunted by Venus on the field, Venus restores 5% of her max HP every 2s (this effect can trigger for up to 5 enemies).
